The five sites the skill builds today

Five different businesses, each with its own type, palette, layout and photography, built by the premium website skill and approved by Blake on 10 September. Scroll inside each page to see the whole site, then leave your feedback beside it.

Shown as full-page captures at 780 pixels wide. Each site has two scroll-controlled films (the hero and a mid-page chapter); the captures show their still frames, because the videos are not in the skill package.
